protocol.dataset: same immutable qualified recovery expert TRAIN and full validation manifests as original fits; final conditions unopened
protocol.partition: whole physical runs; same train, validation, and final conditions as BC
protocol.observations: learned_policy.contract.features sensor allowlist only; no teacher phase, absolute time, evaluator or privileged poses
protocol.actions: same 20 learned_policy.contract.ACTION_NAMES, same walker and calibrated servo
protocol.normalization: train frames only for continuous feature mean/std floor0.01; explicit shared UNIT_SCALE_FEATURES mask/probability/age channels mean0 scale1; binary action coordinates mean0 scale1
protocol.padding: repeat first observation for missing past; repeat last action for future padding but mask padded targets from loss; never cross episode boundaries
protocol.selection: minimum deterministic validation epsilon MSE; fixed validation noise seed142; no final-set scores or closed-loop tuning
protocol.runtime: CPU, one torch thread, seeded generator42 reset per episode; replan every4commands; no teacher fallback
protocol.decoding: shared fixed velocity clips; grip0 or0.028 threshold0.014; binary flags threshold0.5; shared calibrated arm limits
protocol.evaluation: same85s physical horizon, identical initial physics, validate_v4 strict current1s settling; preserve every failure
protocol.claim_scope: compact from-scratch diffusion action-chunk baseline, not a pretrained VLA or state-of-the-art policy
protocol.normalization_amendment: prefit correction approved before recovery dataset access or any final evaluation; shared contract.input_statistics with recurrent BC
protocol.revision_reason: Correct the original256wide first-layer rank bottleneck on320 noisy action coordinates; original checkpoints and all failures retained. This does not establish that the bottleneck caused every failure.

metric_scope: teacher-window denoising objective; not closed-loop task success
